title: The Tug-of-War Game
body: Four dogs play tug-of-war with a toy. Astro (A) pulls with a force of $$160.0$$ N in a direction $$55**\circ$$ south of east. Balto (B) pulls with a force of $$200.0$$ N in a direction $$60**\circ$$ east of north. Clifford (C) pulls with a force of $$140.0$$ N in a direction $$55**\circ$$ west of north. Dug (D) pulls just hard enough and in just the precise direction so the toy experiences a net force of $$0$$. That is, when the four force vectors are added together, the resultant is zero. Find the magnitude and direction of Dug's force.
